_comment: Timing constants for smooth viseme interpolation in Three.js. Used by the frontend avatar controller to lerp between mouth shapes.

interpolation._description: Duration (ms) to transition between two viseme shapes. Short enough to feel natural, long enough to avoid jarring snaps.

viseme_hold_durations_ms._comment: How long each viseme shape is held before transitioning to the next phoneme.

blink_animation._description: Full blink (close → hold → open) total duration.

_lipsync_offset_note: Negative offset starts lip movement slightly before audio to compensate for rendering latency.

weight_scale._comment: Multiply all phoneme blendshape weights by this factor. 1.0 = full expression, 0.7 = subtle.

_silence_note: If viseme weight < this value, snap to sil (silence) instead of blending to avoid micro-twitches.
